A modified '''Jedi starfighter''' was, at one point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], stationed in one of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] hangars. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to go on a series of missions to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], a mysterious planet inhabited by the [[Force Priestesses/Legends|Five Priestesses]], and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] accompanied by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Like the [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]], it had hexagonal panels at the end of its [[Wing (technology)|wings]], and, like [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar's]] [[Twin Ion Engine starfighter|TIE starfighter]], it had a compact, sphere-shaped cockpit. Yoda's [[Yoda's crest|personal crest]] adorned the wings of the starfighter.
